items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Text Editors

*   [Umbra](https://umbraeditor.com/) - Native macOS code editor with a built-in coding agent and integrated debugging. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/alex-cova/Penumbra) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [Rakazo](https://rakazo.com) - Open-source app for running self-hosted AI agents with their own computers, memory, and scheduled tasks. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Clipboard Tools

*   [CoPanda](https://www.copanda.app/) - Open-source clipboard manager with a searchable local history, no account and no telemetry. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/rgdevment/CopyPaste) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Utilities / Productivity

*   [Seawall](https://seawall.work/?utm_source=awesome-mac\&utm_medium=listing) - Menu bar app that locks distracting sites and apps until a set time, with a wait if you leave early. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/NikOneZ1/seawall) ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Utilities / Window Management

*   [ordino](https://ordino-app.github.io/ordino/) - Menu bar app that arranges every window on the display with one keystroke, with layouts that adapt to the window count and screen shape. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ordino-app/ordino) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [WinPlug](https://winplug.app/) - Windows-style taskbar with window previews, Alt-Tab between windows, snipping tool and Ctrl shortcuts in one app for people switching from Windows.

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [TradingCalendars](https://tradingcalendars.com) - Offers a free plan for Market Holidays API (10 API calls a day, no card). FX, bank, payment-system, and exchange calendars for fintech and market infrastructure — plus live open, half-day, or closed status for every exchange, through one API.

### Remote Desktop Tools

*   [DeviceView](https://deviceview.ai) - Unattended remote view and control for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux (including Wayland) devices over peer-to-peer WebRTC, right from the browser, plus automations for self-healing fleets. Free for up to 5 devices.

items.title: Public Apis
items.content_text:
### Books

- API: [Sovereign Logos](https://sovereignlogos.com/developers)

  Description: Septuagint, KJV with Apocrypha, Geneva and WEB Bible text with citation links

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Cryptocurrency

- API: [BaniPool](https://banipool.com/docs/api)

  Description: Multichain DEX liquidity pools (Uniswap, Aerodrome, Orca, Raydium) with TVL, volume and fee APR

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No


- API: [SODAX](https://docs.sodax.com/developers/http-api)

  Description: Cross-network swap quotes and intents across 20+ networks, plus token, price and intent data

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Documents & Productivity

- API: [EditPDF Tools](https://editpdf.tools/compress-pdf-api)

  Description: Compress PDF files over HTTPS with 3 quality levels. Free tier: 30 files/month, up to 10 MB

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: No



### Music

- API: [Static Radio](https://staticradio.app/developers)

  Description: Live schedule and listener counts for nine radio stations of independent podcasts

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Shopping

- API: [Prezzi in Vista](https://www.prezzinvista.it/developers/)

  Description: Offers in the weekly flyers of Italian supermarket and electronics chains, with the nearest store

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes



### Transportation

- API: [GADUIN](https://gaduin.com/docs/api)

  Description: Flight status, airport and rail station boards, ship traffic at 28 chokepoints, 667 port boards

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Unknown



### Vehicle

- API: [Census EV](https://censusev.com/api/v1)

  Description: Electric and plug-in hybrid cars for sale in the US, with price, mileage, range and price history

  Auth: No

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Yes

items.content_text:
